summary: The agent provenance envelope is added exactly once, by the printer, and carries the caller's real source: a command that already knows its provenance hands it to printOutputWithFlagsMeta rather than pre-wrapping and printing through a path that wraps again.
reason: printOutputWithFlags labels output "local" because it has no provenance to report, and that assumption becomes a false claim when a caller that does know its provenance wraps first and prints through it — the result is two nested envelopes whose outer one contradicts the inner. Search hit this the moment its live path started succeeding: live results were announced as local. The condition that decides whether the printer wraps now lives in one predicate both sides consult, so the two layers cannot drift back apart.
validated_outcome: TestSearchAgentEmitsSingleEnvelopeWithTrueProvenance fails against the pre-fix source with a nested envelope and passes after; TestSearchNonAgentJSONKeepsSingleProvenanceEnvelope pins that plain --json still carries exactly one envelope. Full go test ./... green.
